title: 载波断点台：GNSS 周跳候选、多频组合与弧段修订史

baseline.preservation_policy: pseudorange, carrier, Doppler, LLI, C/N0, clock events, frequency number, and observation codes are stored exactly as pasted per epoch

replay_steps.expected: additional equal legal integer hypotheses remain visible
only G01 L1 dependent derived rows expire; G02 and G03 remain reusable
accept and then override produce offset-layer events without deleting the prior decision

domain_rules.judgment: ionosphere-combination, Melbourne-Wubbena, and time-difference may return different candidates; no detector is treated as truth
receiver-wide clock events are separated from a satellite-specific cycle slip
accepted repairs are stored only as offset layers and never overwrite carrier raw fields
when integer selection is not unique, all legal candidates and rejection reasons are retained
